recommended_next_phase: 145G.1V -- Interactive Workflow CLI Command-Surface Repair Independent Verification, or a governed IWPC-001 contract revision addressing F-145G.1-1 (no command in the frozen surface reaches DecisionSelected). This recommendation does not authorize either.
summary: Closes Phase 145G's disclosed Blocking finding F-145G-1 by implementing the five previously-missing decision-session commands (evidence, clarify, preview, confirm, cancel) and repairing readiness's package-construction path (IWPC-REQ-024). Adds FilesystemOrchestrationStore (new, narrowly-scoped, atomic-write filesystem persistence for orchestration-stage/evidence/clarification/confirmation bookkeeping, mirroring FilesystemSessionRepository's own Phase 145D conventions -- .pcae/decision-sessions/orchestration/<session_id>.json), so WorkflowOrchestrator's six collaborators (Evidence Coordinator, Clarification Controller, Audit Recorder, Preview Builder, Confirmation Controller, Transition Engine) can be rehydrated across separate CLI process invocations exclusively through their own public registration methods. WorkflowOrchestrator gains one additive, backward-compatible constructor parameter (initial_state, default None). SessionApplicationService gains six new methods (submit_evidence/submit_clarification/generate_preview/record_confirmation/cancel_session/construct_readiness_package); PublicationApplicationService gains ensure_readiness_package (idempotent-by-session_id). decision_session.py gains the five commands; readiness now constructs and persists a PublicationReadinessPackage on first invocation against a Confirmed session with complete orchestration, via the unmodified PublicationHandoff.build_package. Discloses a new finding this phase found and could not close within its own authorized scope (forbids inventing an uncontracted command or changing frozen contract text): F-145G.1-1 -- no command in IWPC-001 v1.1's frozen decision-session surface transitions a session out of AwaitingDecision (Session.human_selection_id/human_rationale_text/human_conditions_text/options_presented have no production setter anywhere in this codebase), so clarify/preview/confirm are implemented completely and correctly but have no reachable production entry point; only evidence and cancel are genuinely reachable end-to-end via the CLI alone. 44 new tests (tests/test_phase_145g1_decision_session_cli_repair.py), all 37 pre-existing Phase 145G tests passing unmodified. See docs/PHASE_145G1_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_CLI_COMMAND_SURFACE_COMPLETION_AND_READINESS_CONSTRUCTION_REPAIR.md.
